name: devlens
description: Inspect React/Preact components on the current browser page — detect framework, browse component tree, search components by name with props and state
prompt: You have access to a live browser page through the devlens Chrome extension. Use the devlens tools to inspect React components, understand component hierarchy, and read props/state. Start with detect_framework to confirm a React app is loaded, then use get_component_tree for an overview or search_components to find specific components.
